SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.DescriptionHint: Only the description is saved. The advance's choices and the character are not changed.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.DropEdge: Drag and drop an edge here
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.DropEdgeReplace: Drop a different edge to replace it
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.NoSkills: No skills are at or above their linked attribute.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.PlannedHint: A planned advance keeps its choices but doesn't change the character. Planned advances are always last, so marking this as planned also marks every advance after it, and marking it as no longer planned also changes every advance before it.

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Requirements.Unverifiable: This requirement can't be checked automatically
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Requirements.OncePerRank: Can only be taken once per rank

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.RequirementsWarning.Title: Requirements Not Met
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.RequirementsWarning.Prompt: {name} does not meet the requirements for this edge. Do you wish to add it anyway?

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.AttributeWarning.Title: Multiple Attributes
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.AttributeWarning.Prompt: {name} has already increased an attribute this Rank. Do you wish to continue anyway?

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Delete.Prompt: Are you sure you want to delete this advance?
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Delete.PromptUndo: Are you sure you want to delete this advance? Any changes it made to the character will be undone.

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Undo.MissingItem: Could not undo the changes to {name} because it is no longer on the character.

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Warnings.NotAnEdge: Only edges can be dropped here.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Warnings.AddFailed: The advance could not be added.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Warnings.EditFailed: The advance could not be updated. Some of its changes may have been applied to the character.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Warnings.DescriptionFailed: The description could not be saved.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Warnings.DeleteFailed: The advance could not be deleted. Some of its changes may have been undone.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Warnings.PlannedFailed: The planned advances could not be changed. Some of their changes may have been applied to or undone on the character.

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.PlannedWarning.Title: Change Planned Advances
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.PlannedWarning.ToPlanned: This advance and every advance after it will be marked as planned. Their changes will be undone on the character but their choices are kept so they can be applied later. Do you wish to continue?
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.PlannedWarning.ToApplied: This advance and every advance before it will no longer be planned. Their changes will be applied to the character. Do you wish to continue?
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.PlannedWarning.Untracked: Advances that weren't created by SWADE Advancement only have their planned status changed. Their changes to the character can't be undone or applied automatically.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.PlannedWarning.Issues: Applying these advances causes the following problems:

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.LoadedFromDescription.All: This advance wasn't created by SWADE Advancement. Its choices were read from its description. If changes are made and saved, the previous choices will be undone as though they had been made by the module.
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.LoadedFromDescription.Some: This advance wasn't created by SWADE Advancement. Some of its choices were read from its description but not all of them could be matched. Saving doesn't undo anything it did.

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Issues.EdgeRequirements: {name} would no longer meet its requirements ({requirements})
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Issues.SkillMissing: {name} is raised with a single skill advance but the character would not have the skill yet
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Issues.SingleNotEligible: {name} would be below its linked attribute so it can't be raised with a single skill advance
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Issues.TwoNotEligible: {name} would no longer be below its linked attribute so it can't be raised with a two skills advance
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Issues.AttributeTwice: This would be a second attribute increase in the same rank
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.Issues.HindranceMissing: {name} would already be gone so there is nothing left to decrease

SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.IssuesWarning.Title: Later Advances Affected
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.IssuesWarning.EditPrompt: Saving this change causes the following problems with later advances. Do you wish to save it anyway?
SWADE_ADVANCEMENT.IssuesWarning.DeletePrompt: Deleting this advance causes the following problems. Do you wish to delete it anyway?
